text.p: Results of English county championship matches on Monday:
Worcester: Worcestershire beat Glamorgan by 54 runs. Worcestershire 476-9 declared and 295, Glamorgan 398 and 319 (S.James 130.).

Hove: Gloucestershire beat Sussex by 166 runs. Gloucestershire 320 and 331-7 declared (T.Hancock 84, M.Alleyne 77, J.Russell 69 not out), Sussex 324 and 161 (N.Taylor 62, M.Peirce 54; M.Ball 5-66, R.Davis 4-35).
Portsmouth: Hampshire v Yorkshire - match drawn. Yorkshire 501-8 declared, Hampshire 281 and 471-9 declared (G.White 145, J.Stephenson 114, J.Laney 81; G.Hamilton 5-89).
Nottingham: Nottinghamshire v Somerset - match drawn. Somerset 337 and 338-6 declared, Nottinghamshire 356 and 305-9 (M.Dowman 124, N.Astle 60).
